summary: Stylesheet for the two /how-it-works/ pages. Defines NO design tokens — it is imported after docs.css and rides its tokens and nav/footer chrome, adding only --paper/--paper-ink/--paper-line/--faint/--ember-dim under body.how-page because docs.css lacks those. Every rule is scoped under .how-page precisely because docs and blog load the same docs.css and would otherwise inherit these styles. Holds the two signature figures (.ring-* for the notebook loop, .temp-* for the index temperature split) plus a prefers-reduced-motion block that must be extended whenever a new animated selector is added.
